name: resume-job-matching-agent
description: Portable framework-independent AI agent for resume profiling, job description profiling, skill matching, qualification gap analysis, compatibility scoring, and application-readiness reporting.
author: HiDevs Community

capabilities.name: resume_profiling
capabilities.description: Extract structured skills, experience, education, and credentials from a resume.

capabilities.name: job_description_profiling
capabilities.description: Extract required skills, preferred skills, responsibilities, and experience requirements from a job description.

capabilities.name: skill_matching
capabilities.description: Perform explainable comparison between candidate resume skills and job description skills.

capabilities.name: qualification_gap_analysis
capabilities.description: Identify missing requirements and experience gaps without fabricating data.

capabilities.name: compatibility_analysis
capabilities.description: Calculate a deterministic, explainable compatibility score based on configurable criteria.

capabilities.name: recommendation_generation
capabilities.description: Generate practical resume enhancement and job-fit recommendations based on evidence.

capabilities.name: matching_report
capabilities.description: Produce a comprehensive structured compatibility report summarizing profiles, matches, gaps, and recommendations.
